input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 already contains a Vendor-side insurance clause meeting or exceeding the preferred position: CGL of USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, professional (E&O) of USD 2M, cyber and privacy liability of USD 5M (Vendor is a hosting provider processing Customer Data), workers' compensation as required by law, plus employer's liability of USD 1M as an extra. Coverage runs throughout the term and one year afterward, matching the model language. Section 18.2 gives an unconditional obligation to provide certificates of insurance and evidence of coverage on request, and confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities. The only softeners — primacy "where commercially customary" and cancellation notice "to the extent available from its insurer" — relate to terms the playbook does not require and are market-standard carrier limitations, so no redline is proportionate.
